text:
During the day, the sky appears blue because of a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering. Sunlight is composed of all colors of the visible spectrum, and shorter wavelengths (like blue and violet) scatter more easily when they encounter air molecules. This scattered light fills the sky, making it appear blue.
